items.title: 'I am shocked': Unpacking One Nation's spectacular rise in the polls
items.description: Pauline Hanson's One Nation has seen the fastest polling rise in modern Australian politics. What is going on?

items.title: Liberals fix paralysing uncertainty but morale follows results not reshuffles
items.description: The paralysing uncertainty that weighed on the Liberals' faces has lifted for now, but morale in politics follows results rather than reshuffles.

items.title: Two Hollywood stars, one unconventional family and the talks they never had
items.description: Sophie Hyde's films have won awards at Sundance and Berlin, but she has more riding on her latest release. She's turned the lens on the long-held secrets of her unconventional family.

items.title: Live: Ukrainian makes political statement as Australia enjoys its best Winter Games
items.description: Ukrainian skier Kateryna Kotsar writes "freedom of memory" on her gloves in an apparent reference to compatriot Vladyslav Heraskevych's disqualification for wearing images of slain athletes on his helmet. Follow live.

items.title: Rise of Australia's public economy compares to mining boom of the 2000s
items.description: Long-term structural shifts have gravitational forces that are hard to escape, says a Westpac economist.

items.title: The right to protest and reasonable police response is under scrutiny
items.description: From 418 arrests in 1977 to fresh clashes in Sydney: The fragility of Australians' right to protest and what makes a reasonable police response is under scrutiny

items.title: A millionaire bought a football club while drunk then forgot
items.description: Rob Smethurst was in the throes of a four-day drunken bender when a friend called and told him his local football team was for sale. Now his tiny English club is making global headlines.

items.title: 'Land on a silver platter': Palestinians reflect on new Israeli West Bank plans
items.description: As Israel's security cabinet agreed on a plan that would pave the way for future settlements in the occupied West Bank, Palestinians say the pressure from Israeli settlers is relentless.

items.title: Former site of Australia's deepest coal mine now waterfront townhouses
items.description: What was once a working class, coal-fuelled borough is now a sought-after suburb in Sydney's inner west, with houses selling for millions.

items.title: Police block road near Nancy Guthrie's home during investigation
items.description: Authorities investigating the disappearance of American morning show host Savannah Guthrie's mother seal off a road near Nancy Guthrie's Arizona home.

items.title: 'More outbreaks' of deadly zoonotic disease in southern Australia

items.title: 'You have the wrong person': Appeal to kidnappers for safe return of elderly man

items.title: Beaches previously untouched by algal bloom 'hit with a vengeance'

items.title: This Olympic legend's acts of selflessness earned him a rare award
items.description: As Bree Walker aims to create Olympic history in the women's monobob, she will do so on a track named after a man who made history of his own through one of the Winter Games' most selfless acts.

items.title: Parched start to 2026 for southern Australia as east coast lows dry up

items.title: Another Sunday. Another chance to embarrass yourself. Let's play, HARD!

items.title: Russia poisoned Alexei Navalny, UK and allies say

items.title: De Minaur reaches third-straight Rotterdam final
items.description: Alex de Minaur becomes the first man to reach three consecutive finals at the Rotterdam Open.

items.title: Carlton star taken to hospital as Victoria holds off WA in AFL Origin

items.title: Brumbies shines as Force wilt in the Perth heat

items.title: 'Sick of the regime': Thousands march in support of change in Iran
items.description: Organisers billed the protest as part of a "global day of action in solidarity with Iran's Lion and Sun revolution".

items.title: Travel industry sounds alarm as US enters another partial shutdown
items.description: After Congress failed to pass laws necessary to fully fund the US government, one of its biggest departments has shut down.

items.title: These Kennedys were an 'It' couple — until their untimely demise
items.description: The public's obsession with one of America's most storied political dynasties has been fuelled by tragedies, such as the doomed romance between John F Kennedy Jr and Carolyn Bessette.
